BiblicalUsage: Elijah girded up his loins and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel, with the hand of the LORD upon him. The word is the cinching of a belt before a run, and it stands alone in the Bible.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a prophet girds his loins to run, because the hand of the LORD makes a man faster than a king's chariot.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
